questions.markdown: Determine the minimum value of $x^2yz^3$ subjected to the condition $2x+y+3z=3$.
If $z=4x-y^2$ where $x=uv^2$ and $y=u^3v$ then find $\dfrac{\partial z}{\partial u}$ and $\dfrac{\partial z}{\partial v}$.
If $u=\cos^{-1}\!\left(\dfrac{x+y}{\sqrt{x}+\sqrt{y}}\right)$, then prove that $x\dfrac{\partial u}{\partial x}+y\dfrac{\partial u}{\partial y}=-\dfrac{1}{2}\cot u$.
Show that the plane $x+2y-z=3$ cuts the sphere $x^2+y^2+z^2-x-z-2=0$ in a circle of radius unity. Furthermore, find the equation of the sphere which has this circle as a great circle.
Expand $f(x,y)=e^x\log(1+y)$ in powers of $x$ and $y$ up to the 3rd degree terms.

Test the convergence of the series

$$
\frac{2^2}{3^2}+\frac{2^2\cdot 4^2}{3^2\cdot 5^2}+\frac{2^2\cdot 4^2\cdot 6^2}{3^2\cdot 5^2\cdot 7^2}+\cdots
$$
Evaluate $\int_0^a\int_y^a \dfrac{x}{x^2+y^2}\,dy\,dx$ by changing to polar coordinates.

questions.markdown:
Using Laplace transforms, solve the differential equation

$$
\frac{d^2y}{dt^2}-3\frac{dy}{dt}+2y=1-e^{2t}
$$

subject to the conditions $y(0)=1$ and $y'(0)=0$.

Express the function

$$
f(t)=\begin{cases}t-1; & 1<t<2\\3-t; & 2<t<3\end{cases}
$$

in terms of unit step function and hence find $L\{f(t)\}$.

Test the absolute and conditional convergence of the following series

$$
x-\frac{x^2}{\sqrt{3}}+\frac{x^3}{\sqrt{5}}-\cdots
$$
Using triple integrals, find the volume bounded by the cylinder $x^2+y^2=4$ and the planes $y+z=3$ and $z=0$.

Use beta and gamma functions to show that:

$$
\int_0^{\pi/2}\sqrt{\tan\theta}\,d\theta\times\int_0^{\pi/2}\sqrt{\cot\theta}\,d\theta=\frac{\pi^2}{2}
$$
